message: No detected input validation: The code reads config.json and calibration XML/FileStorage files without any schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the loaded fields.

No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths only; no remote fetching is performed, so no checksum or authentication controls are present or needed—but none exist either.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values against an expected set, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected model integrity verification: The code imports and instantiates models (MultiView_Detection, resnet18) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading pretrained weights or serialized model files.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no explicit isolation of a held-out test set from training data, no signing or hashing of evaluation data, and while multiple metrics (precision, recall, accuracy) are computed, there are no structural protections against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: There are no input shape/range checks, schema validation, or malformed-input rejection visible in the inference data-flow path; data is passed directly to the model after a .to(device) call.

No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are thresholded with a configurable cls_thres but there are no NaN guards, probability sanity bounds, or other post-inference validity checks on the raw output values.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a computer-vision multiview detection pipeline, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
